texts: Three New England calls change before Sunday at BUF. Drake Maye comes off the QB1 line, TreVeyon Henderson comes out of the flex, and Mack Hollins, not Romeo Doubs, is the A.J. Brown pivot. Let's look into it. #NEPats #BillsMafia

Maye: 1 TD pass, 6 INT, 9 sacks, under 13 fantasy points every game. Sit Maye. Henderson: Stevenson took the passing downs and short yardage at JAX, 3 catches to 1. Sit Henderson. Hollins: 9 targets, 6 for 87, most snaps at receiver. Flex Hollins over Doubs. #NEPats

Every New England row on the Menu carries the change, and the order moves Friday after the injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
